```css
:root {
  --topbar-h: 60px;
  --drawer-w: 420px;
  --filters-h: 0px;         /* dynamic: set by JS when filters open/close */
  --drawer-gap: 14px;       /* outer margin around the drawer */
  --topbar-gap: 10px;
  --map-drawer-gap: 8px;  
  --map-outer-gap: 14px;
  --warn: #ffffff;     /* Bootstrap warning */
  --warn-d: #e4e4e4;   /* Bootstrap warning (hover/darker) */
  --fx-fast: 220ms;
  --fx-slow: 420ms;
  --fx-slower: 560ms; 
  --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);  /* “standard” ease-out */
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
body { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; color: #111; }

.topbar {
  height: var(--topbar-h);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  background: #fafafa;

}
.brand { font-weight: 700; }
.toolbar .filters { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }

.filters select, .filters button {
  height: 34px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 6px; background: white;
}

.page {
  height: calc(100vh - var(--topbar-h));
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}
#map {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  width: 98.6%;
}
/* When the details drawer is open, give the map space on the right */
/* when drawer opens, reduce map width by drawer width + its side gaps */
body.drawer-open #map {
  /* shrink a bit more to create a gutter to the left of the drawer */
  width: calc(100% - (var(--drawer-w) + (2 * var(--drawer-gap)) + var(--map-drawer-gap)));
  margin-right: calc(var(--map-outer-gap) + var(--map-drawer-gap));
  transition: width var(--fx-slow) var(--fx-ease);
}
/* OL default tweaks */
.ol-control button { background: white; border-radius: 4px; }


/* Compact toolbar */
.toolbar-compact {
  display: flex;

  gap: 8px;
}

/* Small button group */
.btn-group {
  display: inline-flex;
  border: 1px solid #cfd3d8;
  border-radius: 10px;           /* was 999px */
  overflow: hidden;
}
.btn-group .btn {
  padding: 6px 8px;             /* a bit taller/wider */
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  border: 0;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 0;              /* squared inside the group */
}
.btn-group .btn + .btn {
  border-left: 1px solid #cfd3d8;
}
.btn-group .btn.active {
  background: #eef1f5;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.btn-group .btn:hover {
  background: #f6f8fa;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn { border-radius: 8px; }
.btn-outline { border: 1px solid #cfd3d8; background: #fff; }
.btn-outline:hover { background: #f6f8fa; }
.btn-solid {
  border: 1px solid #1d4ed8;
  background: #1d4ed8; color: #fff;
  padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 12px;
}
.btn-solid:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); }

/* Solid warning button – same shape/weight as .btn-solid, but amber */
.btn-warning {
  border: 1px solid var(--warn-d);
  background: var(--warn);
  color: #111;                 /* readable on amber; switch to #fff if you prefer */
  padding: 8px 14px;
  font-size: 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.btn-warning:hover {
  filter: brightness(0.97);
  background: var(--warn-d);
  border-color: var(--warn-d);
  color: #000000;                 /* small touch on hover */
}

.sep {
  width: 1px;
  height: 20px;
  background: #e5e7eb;
  margin: 0 6px;
}

/* Layout: header is fixed height; main is column with filters + map */
.topbar { min-height: 56px; }
.page {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: calc(100vh - 56px);
}

/* Filters panel (collapsible with smooth animation) */
.filters-panel {
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #ffffff;
  /* border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; */
  border: 1px solid #c2bccc;       /* black border */
  border-radius: 12px;          /* curved edges */
  margin: 0 var(--drawer-gap);  /* side margins always; no vertical gap when closed */
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  /* transition: max-height 260ms ease, opacity 240ms ease; */
  transition:
    max-height var(--fx-slow) var(--fx-ease),
    opacity   var(--fx-fast) ease,
    margin    var(--fx-slow) var(--fx-ease);
}
.filters-actions {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}
/* .filters-panel.open {
  max-height: 320px; 
  opacity: 1;
  overflow: visible; 
} */
.filters-panel.open {
  max-height: 320px; /* adjust if your form is taller */
  opacity: 1;
  overflow: visible;
  /* add side margins and small top gap but remove bottom gap to avoid double spacing with map */
  margin: var(--topbar-gap) var(--topbar-gap) 0 var(--topbar-gap);
}

.filters-form {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: end;
  padding: 10px 12px;
}
.field { display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.field > span { font-size: 12px; color: #374151; }

.filters-form select {
  min-width: 220px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid #cfd3d8;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff;
}

/* District select: nicer arrow + extra right padding */
.filters-form select {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  -moz-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  background:
    url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='14' height='14' viewBox='0 0 20 20' fill='none' stroke='%236b7280' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><polyline points='6 8 10 12 14 8'/></svg>")
    no-repeat right 10px center / 14px 14px #fff;
  padding-right: 36px;              /* ← space for the arrow */
}

/* Optional: consistent focus for selects */
.filters-form select:focus {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(29,78,216,.18);
}

/* Multi-select dropdown */
.multi-select { position: relative; }
.ms-trigger {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #cfd3d8;
  background: #fff;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.ms-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] { background: #f6f8fa; }

.ms-panel {
  position: absolute; z-index: 20;
  left: 0; right: 0; top: calc(100% + 6px);
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  padding: 8px;
  display: none;
}
.ms-panel { z-index: 1000; }
.ms-panel[aria-hidden="false"] { display: block; }

.ms-search { padding: 4px 6px; }
.ms-search input {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 8px 10px;
  border: 1px solid #cfd3d8;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.ms-list {
  max-height: 220px;
  overflow: auto;
  margin-top: 6px;
  border: 1px solid #edf0f3;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 6px;
}
.ms-list[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

.ms-list .check {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 4px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.ms-list .check:hover { background: #f9fafb; }

.ms-actions, .ms-modes {
  display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center;
  padding: 8px 6px 4px 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.radio { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.radio input { accent-color: #1d4ed8; }

/* Map fills remaining space; adjusts automatically when filters-panel opens */
#map {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 300px;
  position: relative;
}
#map {
  /* space around the map */
  margin: var(--map-outer-gap);
  /* rounded corners + proper clipping for OL canvases */
  border-radius: 12px;          /* “slightly curved” */
  border: 1px solid #c2bccc;       /* black border */
  overflow: hidden;             /* ensures tiles respect the radius */
  /* optional subtle depth */
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  background: #f7f7f9;          /* visible while tiles load */
}

/* Right drawer */
.drawer {
  position: fixed;
  /* respect open filters height and add an outer margin */
  top: calc(var(--topbar-h) + var(--filters-h) + var(--map-outer-gap));
  right: var(--drawer-gap);
  bottom: var(--map-outer-gap);
  width: min(var(--drawer-w), 90vw);
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #c2bccc;
  border-left-width: 1px;
  border-radius: 12px;      /* slightly curved edges */
  overflow: hidden;         /* clip inner content to radius */
  box-shadow: -8px 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  transform: translateX(calc(100% + var(--drawer-gap)));
  opacity: 0;
  /* slower + animate top so it glides when filters panel collapses/expands */
  transition:
    transform var(--fx-slower) var(--fx-ease),
    top       var(--fx-slower) var(--fx-ease),
    opacity   var(--fx-fast)   ease;
  will-change: transform, top, opacity;
  z-index: 40;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.drawer.open { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }

}



/* Simple key/value table styling inside drawer */
.kv {

  font-size: 13px;
}
.kv tr + tr td, .kv tr + tr th { border-top: 1px solid #edf0f3; }

}

  padding: 6px 8px;
  word-break: break-word;
}



/* Drawer close button style (reuse Add Layer look) */
.drawer .layer-modal__close{
  background: transparent;
  border: 0;
  font-size: 22px;

  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* Drawer content sections */
.drawer-section{ display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.drawer-section h4{ margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #111; }

/* Compact horizontal bar chart for counts */
.bar-chart{ display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.bar-row{display:block}
.bar-label{ font-size: 12px; color: #374151; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.bar-track{

  border-radius:10px;               /* rounder edges */

/* Road / Asset image gallery */

.imglightbox{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(0,0,0,.6);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center
}
.imglightbox[hidden]{display:none}
.imglightbox__panel{
  position:relative;background:#111;border-radius:12px;max-width:92vw;max-height:88vh;

}
.imglightbox__stage{
  position:relative;background:#000;overflow:hidden;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center
}
.imglightbox__img{max-width:100%;max-height:74vh;transform-origin:center center;transition:transform .15s ease}
```
